title: India's Phone Market Drops 20%: Budget Phones Collapse, Premium Grows! 📉
body: India's Phone Market Drops 20%: Budget Phones Collapse, Premium Grows! 📉
Market research firm CMR revealed that smartphone shipments in India fell 20% in the third quarter of 2026 compared to last year.
The biggest shock is in budget phones: sales of the segment below 7,000 rupees collapsed by 94%, and the mid-range fell 42%.
In contrast, premium phones grew: the segment between 25,000 and 49,000 rupees rose 38%, and the even more expensive segment rose 32%.
Samsung keeps the lead with a 17% share, followed by vivo at 16%, then Oppo and Xiaomi at 12% each, and Apple at 9% — even though the iPhone 17 series accounted for more than half of Apple's sales.
Would you buy a budget phone or save up for a premium one? 🤔
